subject: Translucent anatomical knee, bare femur resting directly on bare tibia, rough spurred bone ends, a red-orange glow where they meet.

camera.movement: Virtual camera already drifting on frame one: a slow steady lateral drift, constant unhurried speed, mechanically smooth, no orbit, no sway. Still drifting at the cut.

motion: The knee bends a little under load, one slow press over two seconds: the femur grinds down onto the tibia, bone on bone, and the red-orange glow at the contact flares hotter, pulsing once like pain, then holds hot. The anatomy keeps its structure every frame: bones hold shape and spacing, joints never separate, muscle keeps its volume, layer order holds.
